hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] || [ ! -f "$f" ] && exit 0; if grep -qIE '(DATABASE_URL|token\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{12,}|secret\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{12,}|api[_-]key\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{12,}|PRIVATE\s+KEY|BEGIN\s+(RSA|OPENSSH|EC)\s+PRIVATE|Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]{20,})' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage":"🔐 Secret detected in %s — review before commit"}' "$f"; fi } 2>/dev/null || true

critic.description: Independent review of Control Tower decisions, Stage 0→1 (read-only)

gpt-critic.description: External adversarial review of Control Tower decisions via Codex MCP (read-only)

reviewer.description: Read-only multi-dimension review across code, docs, architecture, drift, and security triage

scoped-coder.description: Approved-scope implementation only; one write-capable coder per write-set

gpt-verifier.description: External adversarial verification via Codex MCP (read-only)

codex-reviewer.description: Optional extra-deep Codex MCP review beyond the default GPT verifier
